parts.t: Neighbourhood guide · City of Maple Ridge · Cottonwood and Kanaka Creek

Cottonwood is an MLS® sub-area name. The City of Maple Ridge doesn’t publish a boundary for it. It is also not one of the neighbourhoods on the City’s Our Neighbourhoods page, and I found no Cottonwood area plan.
The official anchors I use are Kanaka Creek Elementary at 11120 234A Street, Alexander Robinson Elementary at 11849 238B Street, and TransLink’s route 745, named Haney Place / Cottonwood.
Kanaka Creek runs through this part of the city to the Fraser River, and Kanaka Creek Regional Park follows it.

Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, on October 17, 2026. I have worked in Lower Mainland real estate for 11+ years. Facts come from the official sources noted on this page. Rules and boundaries change, so confirm anything important with the City of Maple Ridge and School District 42.

Trails

Metro Vancouver lists trails for walking, cycling and horseback riding. Canyon Trail runs from the fish hatchery to Cliff Falls, 1.2 km one way with some challenging hills. The flat Riverfront Trails are 3 km one way
Hatchery
The Bell-Irving Hatchery and fish fence support chum and coho salmon and cutthroat trout in Kanaka Creek
Safety
Metro Vancouver says the cliffs at Cliff Falls are steep and slippery and asks visitors to stay out of the creek and canyon there

blocks.text: Planning and flood notes for Cottonwood

parts.t: Plans, zoning and flood rules can be different for each lot.
I found no Cottonwood area plan. The Official Community Plan’s general policies apply, and the City’s 2025 area plan updates were for Town Centre, Hammond, Silver Valley and Albion.

ALR: I did not find an official statement placing Agricultural Land Reserve land inside Cottonwood. ALR status is set parcel by parcel, so check the exact address on the Agricultural Land Commission map.
The City mails its Be Flood Ready guide to properties near the Fraser River floodplain. The guide includes a map of the Fraser River floodplain and an overview of the City’s flood response plan.
The City says a floodplain map shows the area expected to flood on average once every 200 years, and it publishes floodplain maps for the Fraser and Alouette rivers.
The City says it manages flood risk case by case, and that a proposed Floodplain Management Bylaw would set clearer rules, including minimum building elevations.
I found no flood or slope statement written for Cottonwood. Kanaka Creek is a defined watercourse through the area, so ask the City about creek setbacks and hazards for a specific lot.
Metro Vancouver’s park safety note: steep, slippery cliffs occur in many places along Kanaka Creek, especially at Cliff Falls.
Transit: Cottonwood has no West Coast Express station. The nearest is Port Haney Station at 22300 River Road.

TransLink’s Langley–Haney Place Bus Rapid Transit line would run 22 km with 13 stations and service every 10 minutes at peak. TransLink says it is in detailed planning with preliminary funding through the 2025 Investment Plan, and that more funding is needed to deliver it.
No rapid transit line is planned through Cottonwood itself, as far as I found.

FAQ
Where is Cottonwood?
Cottonwood is an MLS® sub-area name. The City of Maple Ridge doesn’t publish a boundary for it.
The official anchors I use are Kanaka Creek Elementary at 11120 234A Street and TransLink’s route 745, named Haney Place / Cottonwood.
How do I get around from Cottonwood?
TransLink’s route 745, Haney Place / Cottonwood, runs from Haney Place into Cottonwood and on to Jackson Road at 103 Avenue, where trips continue as the 746.

Timetable dates: 745, effective January 1, 2024; 746, effective April 20, 2026. TransLink’s August 24, 2026 news post says service improvements on routes 745 and 746 start September 7, 2026, so check the current timetable.
Cottonwood has no West Coast Express station. The nearest is Port Haney Station.
Which schools are in Cottonwood?

The Province’s school list shows Kanaka Creek Elementary at 11120 234A Street and Alexander Robinson Elementary at 11849 238B Street. I found no secondary school in Cottonwood. Thomas Haney Secondary is at 23000 116 Avenue and Samuel Robertson Technical Secondary is at 10445 245 Street.
Catchments are set by address, so confirm a specific address with
School District 42 (SD42)
What parks and library are there?
Kanaka Creek Regional Park is 400 hectares along 12 kilometres of Kanaka Creek, with Cliff Falls as the focal point.
I found no City recreation centre in Cottonwood.
The Maple Ridge Public Library is at 130 – 22470 Dewdney Trunk Road, and it is the only Fraser Valley Regional Library branch in Maple Ridge.
What plan covers Cottonwood?
I found no Cottonwood area plan. The Official Community Plan’s general policies apply.
Is Cottonwood in a floodplain or on a slope?
I found no flood or slope statement written for Cottonwood. Metro Vancouver warns of steep, slippery cliffs along Kanaka Creek, especially at Cliff Falls.
Plans, zoning and flood rules can be different for each lot.
